description: Code-behind for the TheoryExam ASP.NET page that manages displaying theory questions, loading questions from the database, handling user sessions, timing, and submitting answers to the database.

classes.name: TheoryExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing theory exam page functionalities such as question loading, session management, and answer submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; loads questions from the database and initializes timer.

methods.name: getCourseName
methods.description: Returns course name based on course ID.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Handles submission of answers; stores answers into database and updates course queues.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the timer display and checks for timeout.
